name: Cause and Effect Essay
purpose: Explains why something happened, or what resulted from it, by demonstrating the causal mechanism rather than asserting a link.

components.note: States the causal claim being made — which cause(s), which effect(s).

organizational_patterns.name: Single Cause, Multiple Effects
organizational_patterns.description: One cause is shown producing several distinct effects.

organizational_patterns.name: Multiple Causes, Single Effect
organizational_patterns.description: Several independent causes are shown converging on one effect.

organizational_patterns.name: Causal Chain
organizational_patterns.description: A leads to B leads to C — each link is a cause of the next.

pitfalls: Correlation presented as causation with no mechanism shown.
A single-cause narrative for a phenomenon that's actually multi-causal.
A causal chain with a missing link the reader has to infer.
